title: happy crowd at interval.wav by PitchyWobble
author: PitchyWobble
sourceDescription: This is the interval crowd from the play Blithe Spirit that ran at The Basin theatre in 2019. They've all had a good laugh and their about to go back into the theatre and have some more. Although this is an Australian crowd I don't think you can hear any distinct voices or words. It's a happy murmuring.
